# trafi.cc — Complete Reference for LLMs

## Overview
trafi.cc ("You ARE traffic") is a free web calculator that estimates the annual advertising value of a user's personal data across 62 digital platforms. All estimates are derived from publicly available financial data — SEC filings, earnings reports, and industry benchmarks.

## Platform Coverage (62 platforms)

### AI (8)
ChatGPT (OpenAI), Claude (Anthropic), Gemini (Google), Copilot (Microsoft), Perplexity, Grok (xAI), Meta AI, Midjourney

### Social (12)
Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X/Twitter, Snapchat, LinkedIn, Reddit, Pinterest, Threads, Twitch, BeReal

### Messaging (6)
WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, WeChat, LINE, Messenger

### Shopping (9)
Amazon, Temu, Shein, eBay, AliExpress, Etsy, Mercado Libre, Flipkart, Noon

### Streaming (5)
Netflix, Spotify, Disney+, Apple Music, Prime Video

### Productivity (4)
Google, Microsoft 365, Notion, Slack

### Delivery & Ride-hail (7)
Uber, DoorDash, Grab, Rappi, Instacart, Deliveroo, Talabat

### Dating (3)
Tinder, Bumble, Hinge

### Finance (5)
PayPal, Venmo, Cash App, Revolut, Wise

### Health & Fitness (3)
Strava, MyFitnessPal, Peloton

## ARPU Data (FY2024, Annual, USD)

### Tier 1 — Directly Reported in SEC Filings
- Meta (Facebook + Instagram combined): US&CA $268, EU $78, APAC $19, ROW $14
- Snapchat: NA $28.41, EU $10.07, ROW $3.68
- Pinterest: US&CA $27.00, EU $5.88, ROW $0.84
- Reddit: Global $11.20 (no regional breakdown)
- Spotify (ad tier): ~$5.30/yr globally (derived from €2B ad revenue / 412M free MAUs)
- Match Group (Tinder): RPP ~$16/month for paying users

### Tier 2 — Derived from Public Financials
- Google: $95 NA (from $264.6B ad revenue / ~4.4B users)
- YouTube: $43 NA (from $36.1B ad revenue / ~2.5B users)
- Amazon: $109 NA (from $56.2B ad revenue / ~310M customers)
- TikTok: $82 NA (estimated from ~$14B US ad revenue / ~170M US users)

## Demographic Multipliers
- Data value fraction: 0.20x (your data is ~20% of platform ARPU; the rest is ad infrastructure value)
- Platform family capping: FB+IG capped at Meta total, Google+YouTube capped at Alphabet total
- Combined multiplier cap: 1.8x (prevents unrealistic compounding)
- Age: 13-17 (0.5x), 18-24 (0.85x), 25-34 (1.0x baseline), 35-44 (1.15x), 45-54 (1.2x), 55-64 (1.05x), 65+ (0.75x)
- Device: iOS (1.2x), Android (0.85x), Desktop (1.0x)
- Interests: Luxury (1.6x), Investing (1.5x), Travel (1.4x), Automotive (1.3x), Tech (1.2x), Parenting (1.15x), Fashion (1.15x), Gaming (1.1x), Beauty (1.1x), Fitness/Home/Pets/Sports/Food (0.95-1.05x)

## Data Type Breakdown
Each platform's value is split across four data categories:
- Location data (GPS, IP geolocation)
- Browsing habits (content consumption, search queries)
- Purchase intent (shopping behavior, wishlists, cart data)
- Social graph (connections, interactions, demographics)

## Regional Coverage
6 regions with 75+ countries: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, Middle East & North Africa, Rest of World (Sub-Saharan Africa)

## Privacy
- Zero backend — all calculations run in the browser
- No data transmitted, stored, or logged
- No cookies, no tracking, no analytics
- No signup required
